# SATURN

## Takeaway

SATURN couples scRNA-seq with protein-language-model embeddings to create shared cell embeddings across species, supporting cross-species annotation transfer and macrogene analysis.

## Input and output

- Input: species-specific AnnData objects, cell labels and protein embeddings.
- Output: universal cell embeddings, cross-species mapping and macrogene-level comparisons.
- Record: gene identifiers, protein coverage, species labels, model weights and training/evaluation settings.

## Official material

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02191-z
- Code: https://github.com/snap-stanford/SATURN
- Reproducibility archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10258201
- Turnkey entry: python/06_saturn_template.py.

## Limitation

Cross-species similarity can reflect annotation and representation choices. Validate with conserved markers, held-out labels and species-aware QC.
